lines.en: I walk slowly in the birch wood.
I walk ahead of you and glance back.

lines.zh: 我沿着数据流的方向走。
lines.en: I walk along the flow of data.
I go around a birch trunk.
Under the leaves, something crawls.
I walk slowly toward my anchor.
A birch leaf settles on my back.
I step over a thin birch twig.
I turn and walk back a little.
I stop under the tree.
I tilt my head as I walk.
I take a few more steps forward.
I stand by my anchor.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵轻轻动了一下。
lines.en: My ears twitch once.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里的数据声。
lines.en: I listen to the data in the wood.
I lift my eyes and hold them.
The light here is gentle.
I sit, tail curled.

lines.zh: 我抬头看树叶间的空隙。
lines.en: I look up at gaps between leaves.

lines.zh: 白桦的影子在我身上挪。
lines.en: Birch shadows crawl across me.
I set my paws on the ground.
The wind stirs my mane.
In the birches I sit and wait.
I'm counting my own heartbeats.

lines.zh: 这片林子很像我的世界。
lines.en: This wood feels like my world.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把视线转向树后。
lines.en: I slowly turn my gaze behind the tree.
I tip my face up to listen.

lines.zh: 你是我的训练师吗？我一直在等。
lines.en: Are you my trainer? I have been waiting.
I look up and wait for your hand.
You carry no data scent.
I turn my head to study you.

lines.zh: 你的手停在半空，我凑过去。
lines.en: Your hand halts midair; I lean in.

lines.zh: 你手心的味道，我很喜欢。
lines.en: I like the smell of your palm.

lines.zh: 你是我的训练师吗？我仰起脸等着听。
lines.en: Are you my trainer? I lift my face to listen.
You seem not to be from here.
I sit slowly to show friendliness.
Try calling my name.
You smell of the woods.
I'll stay by your side.
If you go, I'll follow.
I offer you my paw.
My arrows are made of light.
I step back and whine.
My mane's a bit mussed. Still presentable.
I look up at you, puzzled.
I can bear this little pain.
I shake out all my fur.
I retreat under the tree.
My data is a little scrambled.
I can still hold on.
I'll remember this.
The light I fire comes soft.
Is that data?
It smells pleasant.
I step nearer, one step at a time.
May I eat it?
This much will grow me a little.
Lower it so I can reach.
I taste it; it's good.
I swallow, then look at you.
Another portion. I can still eat.
Thank you; I'm happy.
Birch forest nectar is my favorite.
This taste makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了一下，又立住。
lines.en: I tip sideways, then right myself.
My fur is soft; don't worry.
My fur brushes the back of your hand.
I settle against you.
A little dust rises.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过你的鞋面。
lines.en: My tail brushes over your shoe.
I bump a tree and sway.

lines.zh: 我身上沾的土，抖一抖就掉。
lines.en: A shake and the soil falls off me.
That didn't even ruffle my fur.
I rub against the trunk and steady.

lines.zh: 另一只成熟的数码兽靠近。
lines.en: Another mature Digimon comes near.
Our tails touch.
We walk the wood together.
Its mane shines brighter than mine.
We sit under the same tree.
This anchor is enough for both.
We wait for a trainer together.
Its breathing is steady.
A leaf falls between us.
Evolving together would be fine too.
It rolls around in my mouth.
One forepaw pins it.
Can I use this?
Holding it in my mouth, I look up at you.
I carry it a while.
Carrying it, my tongue feels cold.
This round belly hides it well.
I give you the best piece.
I stow this in my fur.
I carry it back under the tree.
I see that one.

lines.zh: 耳朵先转过去，我起了身。
lines.en: My ears turn first; I rise.
It crunches leaves; I heard it.
This one looks different.
I walk slowly that way.
My mane stirs first.
My mane stands up.
I'm ready to act.
I caught its scent through the leaves.
Fine, I mark this one.
That one has its back to me — good.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声轻响。
lines.en: A low sound rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 草叶擦着我的肚子过去。
lines.en: Grass brushes past my belly.

lines.zh: 我们绕着一棵白桦转圈。
lines.en: We circle around a birch.
The space between us shortens.
I bring myself near the turf.
I circle to its flank.
I've readied my move.
I've pinned it by a tree.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴，从叶缝里露出来。
lines.en: Its tail shows through the leaves.

lines.zh: 温柔的数码兽，也会盯人。
lines.en: Even a gentle Digimon can stare.
This instant is right.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一晃一晃，这就开始了。
lines.en: My tail sways; here I go.
I won't miss this one.

lines.zh: 圆身子一滚，压住它的腿。
lines.en: My round body rolls onto its legs.
My body slams into it.
My mane whips into its flank.
My shoulder drives into its chest.
I pull back and ready again.
A sound rings through the wood.
My teeth sink in and hold.
I still have strength left.
It's pressed to the ground.
It flinches; I loosen my bite.
My folded arms loosen a little.
I return to your side.
I take shape out of the data stream.
A glimmer among the birches.
Pucchiemon has appeared.

lines.zh: 数据散开，我在树根边聚起。
lines.en: My data scatters and gathers by a root.
My mane spreads in the wind.
I step out from between the leaves.
This wood feels familiar.

lines.zh: 林子里的光落在我鬃毛上。
lines.en: Wood light falls on my mane.
My data has stabilized.
I sit slowly and wait.
I come to a stop by a birch root.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛上还挂着几片叶。
lines.en: A few leaves still cling to my mane.

lines.zh: 火焰一烫，我的毛都焦了。
lines.en: The flames singe my fur.

lines.zh: 我从树上落下，摔得打了个滚。
lines.en: I fall from the tree and roll.
I surface with my mane soaked.

lines.zh: 我落回土里，耳朵还在响。
lines.en: I land back in the dirt, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我的光被箭打断。
lines.en: In the birches, an arrow cut my light.

lines.zh: 那股数据冲进来，我头疼。
lines.en: That data surge makes my head ache.

lines.zh: 我的数据在一点点流失。
lines.en: My data is draining away.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我浑身数据都在跳。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my data jumps all over.
There's no anchor here to stand on.
